source_text: Vinum et siceram non bibant cum intrant tabernaculum. Ebrietas saeculi impedit visionem. Sobrii estote.
pass_a_gloss: Wine and strong-drink not let-them-drink when they-enter tabernacle. Drunkenness of-age impedes vision. Sober be-you.
pass_b_english: [[They shall not drink wine or strong drink when they enter the tent >> Bible:Leviticus 10:9]]. This age’s drunkenness blocks vision. [[Be sober >> Bible:1 Peter 5:8]].
